arrangement.notes: Arrangement follows an aggressive, slow build energy profile with an experimental take on Boom Bap structure. Sample layers use channel names referencing sample chopping techniques such as slice, chop, stab, and retrigger.

event_markers.label: Intro Beat Drop
event_markers.reason: Beginning of slow energy build with drum emphasis

event_markers.label: Bridge FX Transition
event_markers.reason: Experimental sound effects to signal section change

slice.description: Channels consisting of sliced sample parts

sound_intent.character: gritty, rough textures with emphasis on raw drum hits and vocal aggression
sound_intent.dynamic_range: wide with gradual build across arrangement

routing_intent.drums: grouped and routed through bus with saturation
routing_intent.chords: wide stereo spread with subtle reverb
routing_intent.vocal: aggressive, slightly distorted with delay effects

track_roles.drums: rhythmic foundation with experimental sample chops
track_roles.melody: secondary melodic elements to complement vocals
track_roles.vocal: lead vocal aggression and lyrical delivery

designer_intent.focus: achieve aggressive mood with slow energy build using Boom Bap samples and experimental chopping methods
designer_intent.arrangement_style: traditional Boom Bap with variations in sectional energy and texture

presetor_intent.goal: preset adjustments to emphasize grit and dynamics, retaining clarity in aggressive mix
presetor_intent.effects: use of saturation, compression, and subtle modulation effects

sensei_drum.brief: Create and arrange drum patterns using experimental Boom Bap sample chopping techniques emphasizing aggressive groove and slow energy build

bass_generator.brief: Generate bass lines that support groove and energy curve without dominating, fitting Boom Bap style and aggressive mood

harmony_generator.brief: Arrange chordal layers using chopped and sliced samples to complement mood and build energy progressively

melody_generator.brief: Add melodic elements with experimental chops and textures; keep subtle to support vocal aggression

ai_designer.brief: Integrate all elements into cohesive aggressive arrangement with smooth slow energy build and variation

presetor.brief: Apply presets and effects to reinforce gritty, raw boom bap sound and maintain clarity with aggressive dynamics

songgps.brief: Analyze arrangement energy and structure to optimize section transitions and overall flow

ai_mixmaster.brief: Mix tracks preserving aggressive mood and energy progression, emphasizing dynamic range and sample textures
